title: De-duplicate evaluation clients
description:
Remove or clearly archive copied scoring trees so a second origin cannot rot back into existence, and give other clients a stable boundary onto the canonical evaluator.

The public `dataparade-cli` carries a leftover eval/score/identity copy; the next `cli-v*` rsync from the app monorepo does not update scanner, but humans will still run the wrong tree. Plexus `evaluate accuracy` / `evaluate_recall` is a third client and must call the shared evaluator through a library or stable JSON/process boundary rather than reimplementing identity rules.

Recommend deletion over archival: an archived copy that still runs is exactly how a second origin returns.
